title: Vicky the clever Viking.
lines: In a village by the sea, in the cold north, live the Vikings.
They have beards and helmets with horns.
He's the strongest of them all.
The little son is called Vicky.
He isn't as strong as the other Vikings.
He's also a bit scared of wolves.
When he thinks, he rubs his nose.
And then he has a clever idea!
One day the Vikings go on a journey in their ship.
A long ship with a dragon's head at the front and a big striped sail.
Some of the Vikings are always arguing about who can row the hardest.
Then they come to an island.
An angry captain lives on the island.
He has stolen the sheep from a poor little village.
He has locked them up in a fort.
Halvar wants to push the wall down.
But the wall is too strong.
A basket hangs from the kite.
A Viking is sitting in the basket.
The Viking opens the gate of the fort.
The angry captain gets such a fright that he falls into the water.
The Vikings take the sheep back to the little village.
They give the Vikings a big feast.
Halvar lifts Vicky onto his shoulders.
My son may not be the strongest.
But this time not for an idea.
